name: codefori-cli
description: Programmatic bridge enabling external automation, shell scripts, and AI agents to invoke Code for IBM i actions, manage IFS deployments, and trigger builds.

commands.title: Code for IBM i Bridge: Start Server
Code for IBM i Bridge: Stop Server
Code for IBM i Bridge: Reset Auth Token
Code for IBM i Bridge: Show Status
Code for IBM i Bridge: Configure Security Policy

codeForIBMiBridge.port.description: Port for the HTTP Bridge server (0 for ephemeral dynamic port allocation).

codeForIBMiBridge.autoStart.description: Automatically start the Bridge HTTP server upon extension activation.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.policy.description: Security policy for destructive commands: 'prompt' asks agent to confirm in chat and pass confirm flag (default), 'modal' shows VS Code popup dialog, 'block' automatically rejects, 'allow' permits execution.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.promptTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for user confirmation before timing out and rejecting the command.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.customBlocked.description: List of command names, prefixes, or regular expressions that are unconditionally blocked.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.customPromptC.description: List of additional command names, prefixes, or regular expressions that require interactive user confirmation.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.allowedComman.description: Whitelist of command patterns or prefixes exempt from destructive checks.

codeForIBMiBridge.security.enableActionI.description: Inspect commands defined in actions (/run-action) for destructive patterns before running.
